company.name: Secure.com
company.shortDescription: Secure.com deploys governed AI security Teammates to automate heavy security workloads and prevent team burnout.
company.description: Secure.com provides governed AI security Teammates that take on real security work across SOC, GRC, Cloud Security, AppSec, and Red Team functions. Each Teammate operates inside the scope, permissions, and approvals its team defines, so consequential action stays in human hands. Offense finds what's exploitable; defense hardens it, resolves it, and proves the outcome. Teams start with one Teammate and expand coverage as needs mature. The Teammates sit above the stack you already own and deploy in days, handing security teams back hundreds of hours and cutting the grunt work that drives burnout.
